settings.title: Presence Fusion
settings.subtitle: Drive Homey’s native presence from several devices — simply. A Homey API key (Presence) is required once.
settings.people_hint: Enable Fusion, then open a person to link sources and set rules. Native Homey presence is what Flows use.
settings.people_locked: Save a Homey API key in the API tab first. People settings stay locked until then.
settings.api_key_hint: Homey Web App → Settings → API Keys → New. Check Presence (homey.presence). One key for the whole Homey. Keep it private.
settings.api_key_missing: Required to write Homey native presence. Apps cannot do this without an API key (Athom limitation). One key for the whole Homey.
settings.api_key_needed_text: Open the API tab and save a Homey API key with Presence (homey.presence).
settings.api_key_cleared_text: Add a key again to write native presence.
settings.api_key_empty: Paste a Homey API key first.
settings.confirm_clear_api_key: Remove the Homey API key? Presence writes will stop.
settings.type_to_search: Type at least 2 letters to search.
settings.delay_hint: These delays add on top of any debounce already set on Smart Presence, Beacon, etc. If a source already waits before going away, keep Fusion’s away delay low.
settings.help_geo: Turn OFF Homey location-based presence for every managed user. Otherwise Homey and Presence Fusion overwrite each other.
settings.help_api: Homey apps can read presence but cannot write it without an elevated API key. Create a key in the Homey Web App (Settings → API Keys), check Presence (homey.presence), then paste it in the API tab. One key covers all people.
settings.help_api_3: Paste the key in the API tab and Save
settings.help_writers: Don’t use Flows (or other apps) that set the same user’s presence. Fusion should be the only writer for managed people — otherwise they overwrite each other.
settings.help_how_0: Save a Homey API key with Presence (API tab)
settings.enabled_text: Sources can now update native presence for
settings.disabled_kept_text: Fusion stopped. Sources and rules are kept for
settings.confirm_disable_keep: Sources and rules are kept. You can turn Fusion back on later.
settings.err_source_not_found: This linked source was not found.
settings.val_text: Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.
settings.val_quorum: Enter a whole number between 1 and 10.
settings.val_delay_home: Use a value between 0 and 120 seconds.
settings.val_delay_away: Use a value between 60 and 3600 seconds.
settings.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.err_device_not_found: This device is no longer available on Homey.
settings.err_user_not_found: This Homey user was not found.
settings.err_user_disabled: Enable this person in the People tab first.
settings.err_capability: Could not read a suitable capability on this device.
settings.err_network: Connection issue. Check Homey and try again.
settings.err_permission: Homey denied this action. Check the app permissions.
settings.err_api_key: Add a Homey API key with Presence in the API tab.
settings.err_api_key_scope: This API key cannot write presence. Recreate it and check Presence (homey.presence).
settings.err_api_key_invalid: Invalid API key. Check that you copied it fully.
settings.info_no_users_text: Create Homey users first, then reopen these settings.

widget.empty: Enable a person in app settings
widget.needs_api_key: Add a Homey API key in app settings (API tab)
